Container.Name: AutoSpotifySync
Container.Overview: Syncs your Spotify library to a local database, compares it with your Plex music library, and reports what is missing. Optionally downloads missing tracks through a spotify-downloader API, imports them into your music share and verifies them in Plex. Safe by default: AUTO_DOWNLOAD is off and DRY_RUN is on. First run `auth` once from a console to get a Spotify refresh token (see the project README).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, logs and download staging

Config.Name: Music library
Config.Description: The same music share Plex reads. Imported files are written here.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: From developer.spotify.com/dashboard

Config.Name: Spotify Client Secret
Config.Description: From developer.spotify.com/dashboard

Config.Name: Spotify Refresh Token
Config.Description: Generate once with: docker run --rm -it -e SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=... -e SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET=... ghcr.io/hunter-clipper/autospotifysync auth

Config.Name: Public album URLs
Config.Description: Only used without a refresh token (public-only mode, albums only): comma-separated Spotify album URLs

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Your Plex server address

Config.Name: Plex Music Library
Config.Description: Library name. Leave empty to auto-detect if you only have one music library.

Config.Name: Sync playlists to Plex
Config.Description: true = mirror your Spotify playlists and Liked Songs into Plex playlists (exact names, only tracks you have). Honors Dry run and Playlist sync preview.

Config.Name: Playlist sync preview
Config.Description: true = playlist sync only logs what it WOULD create/update/delete and changes nothing in Plex, even if Dry run is off. Use it for the first run, then set false.

Config.Name: Delete removed playlists
Config.Description: Delete the Plex playlist when you delete it from Spotify. Only playlists created by this tool are ever touched.

Config.Name: Downloader URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your spotify-downloader, e.g. http://192.168.1.3:8000

Config.Name: Downloader API Key
Config.Description: The downloader's API_KEY

Config.Name: Auto download
Config.Description: Master switch for downloading missing tracks

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: While true, nothing is downloaded or imported; the log shows what would happen. Set false to go live.

Config.Name: Max downloads per run
Config.Description: Cap on new downloads each run (0 = unlimited)

Config.Name: Sync interval
Config.Description: How often to run, e.g. 30m, 6h, 1d

Config.Name: Download format
Config.Description: mp3, flac, wav or ogg

Config.Name: Download bitrate
Config.Description: 128k, 192k, 256k or 320k (mp3/ogg only)

Config.Name: Notification URL
Config.Description: Discord, Slack or Gotify webhook URL for run summaries

Config.Name: Duration tolerance (s)
Config.Description: Max difference (seconds) between a download's length and Spotify's before it is rejected. YouTube sources often run 6-8s long.

Config.Name: Strict album match
Config.Description: true = a song must match on album too, not just artist and title

Config.Name: Retry attempts
Config.Description: Attempts before a track is parked as failed

Config.Name: Retry cooldown (days)
Config.Description: Days before a parked track is tried again

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error
